description: Northwind Outfitters policy corpus: answerable questions (literal and paraphrased) and unanswerable questions that must abstain.

documents.content:
# Refund policy
Customers may return unused items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Items marked final sale cannot be returned. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after the warehouse receives the item. Return shipping is free for members of the Trailhead loyalty program; other customers pay a flat 6 dollar return label fee.

# Shipping
Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days and is free on orders over 75 dollars. Express shipping arrives in 2 business days and costs 18 dollars. We ship to the United States, Canada, and Mexico only. Orders placed before 1 pm Pacific time on a business day leave the warehouse the same day.

# Warranty
All tents and backpacks carry a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects. Apparel is covered for 2 years. The warranty does not cover normal wear, accidents, or damage from improper care. To file a claim, upload photos of the defect and your order number through the warranty portal; claims are reviewed within 10 business days.

# Trailhead loyalty program
Membership is free. Members earn 1 point per dollar spent and can redeem 100 points for a 5 dollar reward. Points expire 12 months after they are earned. Members who spend more than 1000 dollars in a calendar year reach Summit tier, which adds early access to sales and free express shipping.

# Price match
We match the price of an identical item sold by an authorized retailer within 14 days of your purchase. The item must be in stock at the competitor. Price match does not apply to clearance, auction sites, or marketplace sellers. Contact customer care with a link to the lower price to request an adjustment.

# Gift cards
Gift cards are available from 25 to 500 dollars and never expire. They cannot be exchanged for cash except where required by law. A lost gift card can be replaced only if you have the original receipt showing the card number. Gift cards cannot be used to buy other gift cards.

# Gear rentals
Tents, sleeping bags, and stoves can be rented from our Denver and Portland stores. Rentals cost 20 percent of the retail price per week, with a 3 day minimum. A refundable deposit equal to half the retail price is held on your card. Late returns are charged the daily rate plus a 10 dollar fee per day.

# Repair service
Our repair shop fixes zippers, seams, tent poles, and inflatable pads. Repairs of items still under warranty are free. Other repairs are quoted after inspection and usually cost between 15 and 60 dollars. Most repairs are completed within 3 weeks, and we ship the repaired item back at no charge.

# Sustainability
Since 2023 all of our down insulation is certified to the Responsible Down Standard. Our packaging is plastic free and made from 90 percent recycled cardboard. Through the Second Trail program we buy back used gear in good condition for store credit and resell it at a discount.

# Store hours
Retail stores open from 10 am to 8 pm Monday through Saturday and from 11 am to 6 pm on Sunday. All stores are closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. The Denver flagship store opens one hour earlier on weekends for members.

# Employee handbook
Full time employees accrue 15 days of paid time off per year, increasing to 20 days after 5 years of service. Employees receive a 40 percent discount on full price merchandise. Remote work is allowed up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Performance reviews take place every March and September.

# Travel and expense policy
Employees must book flights in economy class for trips under 6 hours. The daily meal allowance is 60 dollars in the United States. Receipts are required for any expense over 25 dollars. Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the trip through the finance system.

# Information security policy
Passwords must be at least 14 characters and are never shared. Multi factor authentication is required for email and all finance systems. Lost or stolen laptops must be reported to the IT help desk within 24 hours. Customer data may only be stored in approved company systems.

# Product care
Wash down jackets on a gentle cycle with a down specific detergent and tumble dry on low heat with clean tennis balls. Never dry clean waterproof shells; reapply a durable water repellent treatment once a season. Store tents loosely in a dry place rather than in their stuff sack.

# Community events
We host free guided hikes on the first Saturday of every month from each store. Beginner climbing clinics cost 35 dollars and include harness and shoe rental. Events can be booked in the app up to 30 days in advance, and cancellations less than 24 hours before the event forfeit the fee.
